steps: Load the shipped config: write_account_key == "tw"; write_account_proof reports configured, username distinct from t1/t2, roles ok, and exactly the not-yet-provisioned session problem (until the desk runs the tw login).
LensWalk(allow_write=True) on the shipped config: write_acct == "tw"; on a config without write_account: write_acct == the walk account (the named pre-C28 behaviour).
FormFuzz on the shipped config: its LensWalk account is "tw"; the fuzz source carries no hardcoded "t1" assert.
_write_ctx for a write-bearing ticket names account "tw" and the label stem carries "-tw-", distinct from t1's stem.
adversarial: A write account reusing t1's username is refused by the proof (distinctness).
A dangling write_account (naming no configured account) resolves to None — the lane falls back to the named pre-C28 behaviour, never to a phantom.
Once tw is configured, a missing tw session fails pre-flight (C8) BEFORE lens 1 — the lane never silently writes as t1.
